audience: practice managers who set up scheduling and intake forms in IntakeQ

useCases.title: List the services, locations and practitioners you offer
useCases.text: The AI reads the scheduler settings: locations, services with duration and price, and practitioners. You get an overview of the services and locations on offer and the practitioners listed.

useCases.title: List the practitioners in the account
useCases.text: The AI lists practitioners with their id, name, email and external id, for a staff list or a check of who is set up.

useCases.title: Review the questionnaire templates
useCases.text: The AI lists the intake questionnaire templates with id, name, archived flag and anonymous flag, so you can see which templates are archived.
